places.name: Moore's Wall (Hanging Rock SP)
places.access: Free state-park climbing permit required; designated areas only. Small lot: no roadside parking, park hours, carpool

places.name: Pilot Mountain State Park
places.access: Free state-park climbing permit required. Designated walls only; the Big Pinnacle is off limits. Summit lot can close when full

places.name: Sauratown Mountain
places.access: CCC lease from YMCA Camp Hanes. Open only Dec 1-Mar 31, with the CCC's online waiver each year. Enter through the camp
